title: Radar 30X
description: What are the 10 topics growing the most this week, why they work, and how 30X adapts them for leaders in Latin America?
og_description: What are the 10 topics growing the most this week, why they work, and how 30X adapts them for leaders in Latin America?
og_image_alt: Radar 30X. What are the 10 topics growing the most this week?
hero_lead: Why they work, and how 30X adapts them for leaders in Latin America. It answers in one run, in 1 to 3 minutes, and for about 5 cents.
card1_body: It collects public pieces from YouTube, Reddit, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Hacker News.
card2_body: JEV classifies each piece (topic, hook, format, whether it mentions a launch).
card3_body: JEV scores audience fit (applicability, technical level, relevance for LatAm).
card4_body: It proposes three ready-to-copy pieces (carousel, reel, and LinkedIn post) and a list of what is coming.
how_lead: You choose the topic and the networks. The radar does the rest.
how1_body: It works for AI (the main demo), fitness, or any open topic the user writes. YouTube, Reddit, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Hacker News.
how2_body: It brings in the public pieces from the last few weeks and measures how fast each one grows.
how3_body: Each piece gets a topic, a hook, a format, and an audience fit, for fractions of a cent.
how4_body: With its stage, why it works, where it came from, ideas ready to copy, and what is coming.
read_lead: Three ideas for understanding the ranking.
stage_emergente_help: It accelerates fast and few people are talking about it yet. This is the best moment to enter.
stage_creciendo_help: It accelerates and already has volume. There is still room.
stage_pico_help: A lot of volume, but it is no longer accelerating. Enter with your own angle.
stage_saturado_help: Many accounts and slowing down. Better to look for another topic.
weights_intro: The score (0 to 100) combines five signals. In the results you can change how much each one weighs and the ranking reorders immediately: if you raise Early, topics that are just starting win; if you raise Several networks, the ones already on several networks win.
sig_fuerza_read: How fast its best pieces grow and how useful they are for your audience.
sig_fuerza_help: How fast its best pieces grow and how useful they are for your audience
sig_aceleracion_read: Whether it is growing faster than the other topics.
sig_aceleracion_help: It grows faster than the other topics
sig_temprano_read: It accelerates but still has little volume: an opportunity.
sig_temprano_help: It accelerates with little volume: an opportunity
sig_multired_read: How many networks it appears on at once.
sig_multired_help: It shows up on several networks at once
sig_frescura_read: Few accounts are covering it: it is not saturated.
sig_frescura_help: Few accounts cover it: it is not saturated
hooks_intro: The hook is how a piece catches attention in the title or the first seconds. JEV detects it on each piece and the radar measures which one is growing the most.
footer: Radar 30X. Collects, measures, and decides the ranking. It only writes; it does not touch the ranking. Nothing is collected from behind a third-party login or by scraping that violates terms of use, and only data from public pieces is used, never from people.
run_lead: Choose the topic and the networks, then press "Run radar". The results open on their own when it finishes.
readonly_note: Read-only mode: this version shows the latest saved run.
collect_new: Bring in new data from the networks
adjust_note: Change how much each signal weighs. The order updates immediately
weights_note: The code calculates the ranking with these weights. The AI does not decide the order.
legend_up: up 2 places since the previous run
legend_new: it was not in the top of the previous run
coming_lead: Hypotheses, not facts: topics that are not a trend yet, but today's signals point to them becoming one. Strength combines the data (acceleration of the topics it is based on) with the JEV evaluation.
origin_lead: Where each topic showed up first and how it jumped from one network to another.
cost_more: See the cost breakdown, history, and comparison
cost_measured: Measured with the usage field of each JEV and DeepSeek response, not estimated.
compare_q: How much do you pay per month today for trend data?
loading_sub: This takes 2 to 5 minutes. You can leave this tab open.
note_free: A new topic is analyzed from scratch: the first time, acceleration is estimated.
note_usage: Today: {done} of {limit} runs with new data.
err_niche: Write your topic (for example: specialty coffee).
launch_remote: Sending the order to GitHub Actions.
fail_title: The run could not be completed

question: The 10 {topic} topics growing the most this week, why they work, and where they came from.

ideas_sub: Adaptation of topic number 1: "{name}". Copy the text or the prompt and paste it into ChatGPT, Claude, or Canva to generate the piece.
prompt_role_30x: Act as a strategist and content creator for 30X, a Latin American company that teaches AI and business to leaders.
prompt_role: Act as a strategist and content creator.
prompt_write: Write in neutral Latin American Spanish, in a close and practical tone. Deliver {delivery}.
delivery_carousel: the text of each slide (7 to 9 slides), the caption, and 5 hashtags
delivery_reel: a 30 to 45 second script with timings, the on-screen text, and the caption
delivery_post: a post of 150 to 250 words with a call to action at the end
origin_note: First appearance detected among the 10 main topics. On average, a topic takes {days} days to jump to the next network.
ext_note: External sources come from the links shared in Hacker News and Reddit threads.

savings_only: Running every 3 hours, the radar costs about {month} per month.
savings_compare: Today: {pay} per month. Radar every 3 hours: {month} per month ({pct}% of what you pay today).
